title: Evidence map
description: Every factual statement in a capsule points at a span of what was actually said. Evidence lives here rather than inside blocks so that re-aligning or re-segmenting a transcript remaps records without touching a single block. Only the accepted map is preserved; the agent's working map, with its rejected hypotheses, is scratch.

kind.description: Only `accepted` is capsule truth. A `working` map must never be preserved.

quote.description: The exact substring. It costs bytes and buys the offline promise: a viewer with no database can verify that a citation still matches its transcript, so an evidence link that drifted becomes a hard error rather than a plausible-looking sentence.

remappedFrom.description: Survives re-alignment. A record's identity outlives the segmentation it was first written against.

citedBy.description: A derived index, keyed by evidenceId. Convenience only; regenerable from the capsule document.

preservable.description: Set explicitly on a working map so it cannot be mistaken for authored state.
